summary: Android's copy of the pre-session model catalogs is checked against a fixture generated from src/shared/models.ts; GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.4 now show the balanced tier on Android, as on the desktop.

desktop.reason: src/shared/models.ts is unchanged; the desktop already shows these tiers.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo app imports src/shared/models.ts directly, so it cannot drift from it.

storageDataMigration.reason: No persisted data changes; a stored model id is unaffected by its displayed tier.

updateRelease.reason: Ships in the next Android build like any Kotlin change; no channel or packaging change.

notExercised: The Android new-chat picker was not opened on a device; the change is two tier strings.
